newsitem.title: USA: Diamond says Q2 income may be under year-ago level.
newsitem.headline: Diamond says Q2 income may be under year-ago level.

text.p: Diamond Home Services Inc said income for the second quarter of 1997 may fall as much as 50 percent below year-earlier levels.
"Revenues for 1997 to date are approximately seven percent above the comparable 1996 period," the company said.

"Only recently has our installed home improvement business started to see a measurable increase in lead productions commensurate with our ongoing investments in advertising and operating infrastructure," Diamond Home said.

As a result, it said, "Our revised estimates for revenues in the second quarter of 1997, together with ongoing planned investments in advertising and infrastructure, may cause income for the second quarter of 1997 to fall as much as 50 percent below year-earlier levels."
But the company also said it is at the start of its busiest season and did not think it was "prudent to revise our planned investments in advertising and operating infrastructure at this time."
